provenance.capture: libpq PQexecParams with explicit retained parameter OIDs and NULL inputs; declared targets use PQprepare and PQexecPrepared; ordinary SQL uses PQexec.
provenance.normalization: Only dynamic missing-type OIDs are replaced by {parameter_oid}.
provenance.entry_points: Cursor cases compare the same typed query. method:prepared uses PQexecParams to compare source argument binding before assignment to text. prepare/execute_prepared cases use PQprepare/PQexecPrepared with retained target OIDs and NULL arguments; PQexecPrepared has no source type OID argument.
